changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive documentation tool for Australian allied health practitioners.

- Drafts SOAP and other clinical note formats for physiotherapy, OT, psychology, speech pathology, podiatry, and related professions.
- Generates Medicare MBS item number reference tables for billing and compliance.
- Creates patient recall/reminder SMS and email templates.
- Writes GP report letters tailored to Australian standards.
- Includes detailed intake questions and record-keeping requirements based on Australian privacy and Medicare rules.
- All knowledge is embedded — no API calls or external data required.
